name: What should I look for when choosing a commercial water damage restoration company?

mainEntity.name: What should I look for when choosing a commercial water damage restoration company?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a restoration company, look for certifications from organizations like IICRC (Institute of Inspection, Cleaning and Restoration Certification), indicating adherence to industry standards. Verify they have experience with commercial properties, offer 24/7 emergency services, and can provide references. It's also beneficial if they can assist with the insurance claims process. Choose a local company familiar with areas like Encino and North Hollywood for faster response times.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a company with IICRC certifications, commercial experience, 24/7 emergency service, and good references, preferably local.
